rationale: This is a near-clone of the archived "Profitable Inventory Divergence" (identical conditioning gate, identical inventory-growth leg, only the second leg swapped from gross-profit-change-to-assets to gross-margin change), i.e., precisely the cosmetic variant the objective warns against, and both legs also lean on the already-published inventory-growth and margin-deterioration anomalies.

The absolute-deviation-from-maintenance-capex leg is a genuinely non-monotonic reformulation of the investment channel (not just "less capex is better"), it is internally consistent with the positive expected sign, and it plausibly diagnoses the asset-stripping contamination that flipped the earlier Renewal Surplus portfolio evidence — though the ABS(capx−dp)/ppent term will be very noisy for asset-light firms even after winsorization.

The two legs are mechanically entangled — rising capex directly inflates the ppent denominator of sale/ppent, so "declining sales per unit of PPE" is partly implied by the first leg, meaning the conjunction risks collapsing into a double-counted investment-growth (asset-growth anomaly) signal rather than the claimed independent utilization channel.

Internally consistent and economically coherent, and debt-maturity funding is a substantively different channel from the archived equity-funded version, but it reuses that signal's exact template and both legs are close cousins of the well-documented asset-growth and net-debt-issuance anomalies, so incremental novelty is modest.

Expression matches the hypothesis and sign (high MIN = capex near own 5-year high while profitability sits well below its own peak), and using firm-specific historical position/peak distance rather than short-window ACCEL/TREND is a real measurement change from the archived Post-Peak Capex Commitment, not a relabeling.

The aging proxy is largely an accounting consequence of the first leg — sustained capex below depreciation mechanically raises accumulated depreciation and hence ppegt/ppent — so the "conjunction" is substantially redundant and may simply re-sort the same underinvestment variable that already failed to deliver alpha, even though the diagnostic motivation is sensible.
